notes.title: May 5. 2025 Bug Fixs
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs regarding the difficulty of challenges and puzzles.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the Hidden Challenge from being cleared.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the 3-star clear of a stage from being achieved.
- Changed the clear conditions for City 4.

P.S. Thanks again to nana for finding the related bug! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Game Language Support Update
notes.content:
Hello Players!
We are pleased to announce that new language support has been added to our game. You can now enjoy the game in the following languages:

- Japanese
- Chinese (Simplified)
- Chinese (Traditional)

We are thrilled that more players can now enjoy the game in their native language. Simply select your preferred language in the settings menu to apply the changes.

※ This translation was created using AI translation tools. If you notice any mistranslations or areas that need improvement, please share your feedback on our discussion forum. We will actively incorporate your suggestions.

Happy gaming! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Apir 29. 2025 bug fix notice
notes.content:
[h1]Fixed achievement not update bug.[/h1]

Unfortunately, we had to modify our existing data method to fix the update bug in the challenge. As a result, your game information will be lost. We are truly sorry.

This is our first time releasing a game on Steam, so we are experiencing a lot of trial and error. We appreciate your understanding.

P.S. Thanks to nana for reporting the bug. ːsteamthumbsupː
